quests.thesisStatement: Fixing vague claims, a dangling modifier, and choppy flow together turned a weak paragraph into a credible, readable argument.

structuralPillars.sentence: The programme reduced landfill waste by 34 percent within its first year, replacing an earlier vague claim that it 'really helped the environment.'
structuralPillars.guidance: Anchors the central claim or introducing premise so the reader knows what claim is being defended.

structuralPillars.sentence: An earlier dangling modifier, 'Collected weekly, residents filled their compost bins reliably,' incorrectly implied the residents themselves were being collected, and was corrected to properly attach the modifier.
structuralPillars.guidance: Provides essential rationale, contextual evidence, or a vivid concrete illustration supporting the core claim.

structuralPillars.sentence: Several short, choppy sentences describing the collection process were combined into one clear, flowing explanation of how the programme actually worked.
structuralPillars.guidance: Provides essential rationale, contextual evidence, or a vivid concrete illustration supporting the core claim.

structuralPillars.sentence: Together, these fixes turned a vague, hard-to-follow paragraph about the composting programme into a specific, credible, and easy-to-read argument.
structuralPillars.guidance: Synthesizes the broader takeaway, outcome, or strategic payoff of the argument.
